Name: Voids OURple HxW Custom Buildings All in One Pack
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Heyoh! Now fresh out of the press with the new building skin feature! I present the HxW buildings All-in-One but now in OURple! This will be the mod I will be updating for any future HxW buildings in OURple(so the AT variants will be not). 

Currently it gives an OURple skin to: Tea Shop, Conservatory, Winery, Brewery, Restaurant, Bakery and Florist!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Since it uses the new skin feature it should be compatible with any other mod that adds more textures for the HxW buildings!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
